title: Nicole Jirathammakul
seoTitle: Nicole Jirathammakul | Nolan Family Law & Mediation
description: Liam has had a passion for Family Law since high school and has a thorough understanding of the processes surrounding family matters.
html:
Nicole Jirathammakul has been admitted as a lawyer since 2016.

She began her legal career at the Law Society of NSW before going into private practice in 2018.

Nicole has worked exclusively in family law since 2018 and takes pride in resolving legal disputes for her clients by taking the time to understand them, their situation, and the outcome they are seeking.

She knows the importance of providing clear and concise advice to clients and managing their expectations from an early stage. She takes a direct, tailored, and pragmatic approach to resolve matters to ensure the best possible outcomes for her clients.

Her qualifications are:

  • Juris Doctor of Law (post graduate) from the University of Sydney
  • Graduate Diploma of Legal Practice from the College of Law
  • Admitted as a lawyer to the Supreme Court of NSW
  • Admitted as a lawyer to the High Court of Australia
